effect_description_eng: [When Moving] [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Among them, add 1 card with [Sukamon] or [Etemon] in its name to the hand and trash 1 such card. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effects, by deleting 1 other Digimon with [Sukamon] in its name, it doesn't leave.
